name: Gl'lu
description: The Gl'lu are descended from rough-terrain scavenger intimidators and look like nightmarish insectoids. Their porous mottled skin, slimy appendages and periscope-like eyestalk make them look like a cross between a Terran octopus and a slug. Indeed, upon first encountering the race during the Grand Survey, scouts mistook them for a far-flung colony of Githiaskio or genetically altered Hivers. Their body is asymmetric, with two sets of limbs: the front set comprises four legs which have adapted hands, while the rear set consists of three stouter legs for stability and power. The Gl'lu have a single gender and for all intents and purposes are hermaphroditic.

traits.name: Atmospheric Requirements
traits.description: The Gl'lu depend on an ammonia-rich environment and require a sealed suit to survive in any other atmosphere. Without protection, a Gl'lu in a standard oxygen-nitrogen atmosphere will rapidly incapacitate and die.

traits.name: Fast Metabolism (+1)
traits.description: Gl'lu have a heightened metabolism and very fast reactions. They gain DM+1 to all initiative rolls.

traits.name: Heightened Senses
traits.description: Gl'lu have better hearing and sense of smell than humans. They receive DM+1 to any Recon and Survival checks they have to make.

traits.name: IR Vision
traits.description: Gl'lu have highly developed vision in the infrared part of the spectrum and can see clearly in darkness. However, they can only see in infrared — they are effectively blind to the visible light spectrum used by humans and must rely on adapted sensor equipment to function normally in human environments.

traits.name: Natural Weapon (fangs, 1D+2)
traits.description: Gl'lu have sharp fangs that they can use to bite enemies. The fangs do 1D+2 damage and use the Melee (natural) skill.

species_notes: Atmospheric Requirements: sealed suit mandatory in all non-ammonia atmospheres. Referee enforces — a Gl'lu without protection in a standard atmosphere is incapacitated within minutes.
Fast Metabolism: DM+1 to all initiative rolls.
Heightened Senses: DM+1 on all Recon and Survival checks.
IR Vision: no darkness penalty, but the Gl'lu can only see in infrared. Standard human-spectrum lighting and displays require adapted sensor aids.
All careers from the Traveller Core Rulebook are suitable for Gl'lu.
source: Aliens of Charted Space, Mongoose Publishing
